description: This file declares functions related to canonicalization of computation graphs in PyTorch's JIT compiler, including functions to canonicalize graphs and outputs, and utility functions for analyzing uses of values within graphs.
external_methods: bool isBeforeOrAfter(const Use&, const Use&, bool)

methods.name: Canonicalize
methods.description: Performs canonicalization on the provided graph, with an option to keep unique names.

methods.name: CanonicalizeOutputs
methods.description: Canonicalizes the outputs of the given graph.

methods.name: firstOrLastUse
methods.description: Finds the first or last use of a value within a graph, depending on the boolean flag.

methods.name: isBeforeOrAfter
methods.description: Determines if one use occurs before or after another within the graph, used for ordering analysis.
